dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: You know, I feel livelier after hearing your voice... Hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Yes, I love it!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: This place is amazing, beautiful, and peaceful... There's so many wonderful things I've never seen before.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I doubt there's any other place in Teyvat that can compare to this.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Even if you just give me a tiny tent, I'll still be super comfortable here.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Oh, but... if I'm gonna be camping outside, I'll have to trouble you for some firewood to make a campfire...

choices.text: No need for that — it's temperate here year-round!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Th—Thank you... I hope me being here isn't too much of an imposition...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Um... If there's anything I can help with around here, please do let me know!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I used to spend a lot of time cleaning and tidying the house and yard. That was a while ago, but I'm probably still okay at it...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Aw... That's extremely kind of you... Thank you ever so much!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Uh, I guess I should stop with all the formalities before I ruin the mood...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Alright, I'll make myself at home, then. I want to do a detailed survey of this place... I'll do my best to understand your design philosophy!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: That way, I can help you out if you ever need it.

choices.text: All a guest needs to do is make themselves at home.
Of course I'd get you what you need!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Of course!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: It's rare to have time alone with you... I have so many things I want to ask you about.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: For instance, your mastery of the sword allows you to defeat strong opponents that are even beyond the reach of arrows.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Distance and firing range are never a problem to you... How do you manage it?

choices.text: I can show you on the field someday.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Okay, sure... Since we'll be traveling together, watching you fight will definitely be the best way for me to learn.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Um, anyway, let's move on to a lighter topic... What kind of story do you want to hear?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Um... Let me think... Ah, here's an interesting one about the Reconnaissance Company.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: When I first started, we'd pluck the petals off a Sweet Flower to decide who was on cooking duty after work.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Some of us weren't that good at cooking, but no one ever complained. We'd just polish off everything and then give constructive criticism.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: With everyone's feedback and a period of trial and error, everyone's culinary skills significantly improved.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Obviously, our cooking can't compare to what you'd find at restaurants in the city, but they're pretty delicious as field rations go.

choices.text: Why don't we try that method as well?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Good idea! It introduces an element of surprise, too...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Hehe, I'm already looking forward to our next meal... I'll go and collect some Sweet Flowers!

choices.text: It would be an interesting way to choose the chef of the day.
But for now, I want to hear your stories.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Mmm... Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: When the finch adeptus invited me over for some tea, she told me that you can use your willpower to change the topography here.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: If you don't mind... could you find an open place and form one or two mountains there?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter what they look like — as long as it's something that you'd find difficult to climb. The craggier, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: But if that would take too much time and effort, just scrap the idea...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean... you want to go on a hike?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Yes! I'm so grateful for the delicious food and the cozy accommodation you've provided, but I fear that I'll get out of shape if I'm too comfortable for too long...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I still have a long way to go before I can become a well-seasoned surveyor. I can't get complacent.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Besides, understanding the landforms you create will allow me to see what kind of terrain might pose a challenge to you, so I can prepare a plan accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: This way, I'll soon be of some help!

choices.text: I'll give it a go when the time comes.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Hearing that makes me really motivated!

choices.text: Let's challenge the most perilous of terrain together!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Mika.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Have you had breakfast? If not, may I use your kitchen? I won't be long!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Mika.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: It's bedtime already? You have a really healthy routine...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I should take a leaf out of your book... Anyway, sleep tight!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Ah! Something about this place feels familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: This campsite's layout is similar to the example provided in the first version of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Manual...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: You're amazing! How did you manage to remember all these little details...? I'm just in awe!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: What a spacious kitchen! With all this equipment, we could provide enough marching rations for an entire company!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Being here reminds me of the gatherings I had with my teammates.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Although I can't drink with everyone, I'm happy just to be part of the conversation.
